Existing current facts about entities this note mentions:
- memory_id "1000331": In the catalog service, joined writes were locking product updates for seconds at a time.  (about: product catalog, catalog service)
- memory_id "1000108": Team Cinder owns the product catalog.  (about: Cinder, product catalog)
- memory_id "1000529" [decision]: As of 2025-07-17, Diego has the Cinder pager this cycle, taking over from Yuki Tanaka.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000488": As of 2025-06-11, the notifier went to the Dune team, which the Boreal team owned until 2025-06-11; the Cinder team never owned the notifier.  (about: Boreal team, Cinder, Dune team, notifier)
- memory_id "1000401": As of 2025-05-20, the Atlas team owns the indexer, having taken it over from Cinder.  (about: Atlas team, Cinder, indexer)
- memory_id "1000387" [decision]: As of 2025-05-14, Cinder adopted trunk-based development.  (about: Cinder)
- memory_id "1000383": As of 2025-05-14, the Cinder team observed that after the cache change, the webhook dispatcher's memory use grew steadily for a week.  (about: Cinder, webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000021": Yuki Tanaka and Diego are on Cinder.  (about: Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Cinder)
- memory_id "1000596" [constraint]: As of 2025-08-19, deploys to the job scheduler happen only on Tuesdays and Fridays between 09:00 and 10:30 UTC.  (about: job scheduler)
- memory_id "1000269" [constraint]: The catalog service can be released on Mondays to Thursdays between 09:00 and 17:00 UTC; anything else needs an exception.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000606" [constraint]: The ledger service deploys on Wednesdays between 09:00 and 11:00 UTC.  (about: ledger service)
- memory_id "1000335" [constraint]: Deploys to the bus happen on Thursdays between 07:00 and 09:00 UTC and at no other time.  (about: the bus)
- memory_id "1000316" [constraint]: Per the change policy, the webhook dispatcher deploys on Mondays and Wednesdays between 14:00 and 16:00 UTC.  (about: webhook dispatcher)
- memory_id "1000283" [constraint]: The reporting service only ships on Tuesdays and Thursdays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC.  (about: reporting service)
- memory_id "1000217" [constraint]: The authentication gateway deploys on Mondays between 10:00 and 12:00 UTC per the change policy.  (about: authentication gateway)
- memory_id "1000198" [constraint]: The billing API only ships on weekdays after 15:00 UTC.  (about: billing API)
- memory_id "1000538" [preference]: As of 2025-07-21, the Ember team runs its planning on Fridays.  (about: Ember team)
- memory_id "1000356": As of 2025-04-24, feature-flags' p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy.  (about: feature-flags)
- memory_id "1000329" [decision]: Decision on 2025-04-17: the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table.  (about: catalog service)
- memory_id "1000163": During incident INC-2025-004, the notifier missed alerts for 40 minutes on 2025-02-01.  (about: notifier, INC-2025-004)
Existing entity names: product catalog, catalog service, Cinder, Yuki Tanaka, Diego, Boreal team, Dune team, notifier, Atlas team, indexer, webhook dispatcher, job scheduler, ledger service, the bus, reporting service, authentication gateway, billing API, Ember team, feature-flags, INC-2025-004
